finalText:
**Redis died and the whole service went with it.**

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost` ECONNREFUSED `10.0.0.12:6379` at [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182) |
| 02:14:07 | cache degraded, falls back to direct store reads |
| 02:14:10 | store overloads, `TimeoutError` after 5000ms begins |
| 02:15:26 | reconnects start, 13 tries, all refused |
| 02:29:12 | queue depth 502 passes the 500 max |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory, exit 134 |
| 02:31:52 | supervisor kills `api`, service down |

Nothing was wrong before 02:14. Zero requests succeeded after. Redis never came back. Start with why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections. Then add a breaker so a cache loss cannot drown the store.
